title: Southwest's Rough Week, Airlines Accused of Price-Fixing, and Qatar's Hans Zimmer Boarding Music
summary: The NTSB drops a scary report on a Southwest 737 MAX that flew 44 times with undetected tail damage — and then, as if on cue, another Southwest jet loses an engine on takeoff. Plus, airlines get hit with new price-fixing lawsuits, the industry's top lobbyist says everyone's happy while his own survey says otherwise, British Airways trains crews on urine-soaked seats, and Qatar Airways gets Hans Zimmer to score your boarding music.
